cap: CIN is graded by how far atypical basal-type cells extend up the epithelium: the lower third in CIN 1, the lower two-thirds in CIN 2, and more than two-thirds up to full thickness in CIN 3, which includes carcinoma in situ. The two-tier terms group CIN 1 as LSIL and CIN 2 or 3 as HSIL. Only a breach of the basement membrane makes the lesion invasive carcinoma.
